Q1.query: Find first-party Stripe or PayPal availability notices within {period}. Distinguish the incident start from recovery and cite the original notices. If matching notices are not verified, cite the official status resources and say the incident check was inconclusive.
Q1.scope: Payment providers named in the public sources; UTC search window.
Q1.boundary: 공개 장애가 확인되어도 내부 시스템의 제공자와 해당 시간대를 확인하기 전에는 결제 실패의 원인으로 연결하지 않습니다.

Q2.query: Find official US weather or aviation disruption notices within {period}, and report the affected area and time only if verified. Cite NOAA/NWS and FAA sources. If none can be verified for the window, cite the official alert or operating-status resources and say the event check was inconclusive.
Q2.scope: US only; UTC search window. No shipment geography is assumed.
Q2.boundary: 워크샵 주문에는 실제 배송 지역이나 경로가 없으므로 미국 공지를 개별 배송 지연의 원인으로 해석하지 않습니다.

Q3.query: Find CPSC safety notices or NIST cybersecurity guidance relevant to smartphone, smartwatch or laptop categories within {period}. If no new notice is verified, cite applicable official reference material and distinguish it from new notices. Do not name or match any fictional workshop product.
Q3.scope: US regulatory and technical sources; product categories only.
Q3.boundary: 공개 안전·보안 자료는 범주 수준의 정보이며 워크샵 가상 제품의 리콜·보안 문제를 증명하지 않습니다.
